title: Combine related slices
summary: A store can hold several slices under different keys.
introduction: A store can hold several slices under different keys. Your task: Write a selector for the books list in this root state.
learningObjectives: Write a selector for the books list in this root state.
Explain the example for combine related slices

blocks.text: A store can hold several slices under different keys. Each slice still handles its own part of the state.
Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Combine related slices

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createSlice` groups a state value and its reducer rules. Redux Toolkit also generates an action creator for each named reducer.
`configureStore` creates a Redux store from the supplied reducer or reducer map.

blocks.text: The root state has books and theme keys. The theme value is light.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Selectors need to follow the actual root shape. Moving a slice under a key changes its lookup path.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Write a selector for the books list in this root state.
